_comment: Historical upstream registry example for zh667/TokenLedger, retained for reference only. This is not a submission or verification record for SherryXXX8043/dsh-TokenLedger-pro. Prepare a new entry after the Pro fork has been validated against an actual host; do not reuse upstream verification dates or status. Original example: ready-to-paste entry for dshworks/awesome-dsh-plugins data/plugins.json. Validated against that repo's data/schema.json on 2026-08-15: every required field present, category and tags from the allowed enums, no extra keys (the schema sets additionalProperties: false, so this _comment must be deleted before pasting). Machine fields (stars, starsUpdated, pushedAt) are deliberately omitted — the repo's scripts/stars.mjs fills them and CONTRIBUTING says they are not worth editing by hand. Set lastVerified to the day you actually run the check, and keep status honest: verified requires that you loaded it against verifiedAgainst yourself.
